edges: No. 2 Squadron was withdrawn from combat to re-equip with Mitchells.
No. 79 Wing was commanded by Group Captain Charles Eaton.
No. 79 Wing was attached to the Australian First Tactical Air Force by the end of the Pacific War.
No. 79 Wing's combat units included No. 31 Squadron.
No. 18 Squadron was the wing's most active unit.
Plans were made to transfer No. 79 Wing to Northern Command in Papua New Guinea with No. 120 Squadron.
No. 79 Wing joined No. 82 Wing in repatriating RAAF personnel from Borneo to Australia.
